what: Cantonese colloquial markers. Detection for everything, conversion for the subset that is unambiguous (convertChars + convertPhrases), and word-order patterns that no word list can see. Word order and grammar beyond those patterns (你行先 -> 你先走, 畀本書我 -> 給我一本書) still belong to the model: the tool detects, the model rewrites, the tool verifies.
how: Four detection layers, because any one alone is wrong. `chars` are Cantonese-only glyphs. `phrases` are unambiguously Cantonese but built from standard characters (唔該, 嗰個, 乜嘢) and are the only place a shared glyph such as 唔 may appear. `weakPhrases` are Cantonese words that ALSO occur inside ordinary written Chinese across a word boundary (點解 in 早點解決, 屋企 in 房屋企業) - they are reported only when the same line carries a strong marker. `patterns` catch word order (行先, 食緊, 畀…我).
weak_rule: A weakPhrase counts only if the same line also has a Cantonese-only glyph, an unambiguous phrase, or a pattern match. Measured reason (2026-09): 「房屋企業在旁邊度過，早點解決問題。」 produced three hits under plain substring matching, and the write hook would have blocked an ordinary sentence. Known cost, deliberately accepted: a line that is Cantonese but uses ONLY weak words (「點解你要走？」) is no longer flagged - the project's rule is 寧可漏，不要誤判, because a false alarm blocks a write while a miss only loses a hint. The alternative (report weak hits as a NOTE instead of a block) is written up in references/cantonese.md.
convert_rule: A string is converted only when it cannot occur in written Chinese at all: the key contains a Cantonese-only glyph (the `chars` list) or 唔, whose Mandarin use is an interjection always followed by punctuation. Phrases made only of standard characters stay DETECT-ONLY, because a greedy table would corrupt ordinary text: 屋企 in 房屋企業, 邊度 in 旁邊度過, 得閒 in 取得閒置, 而家 in 因而家庭, 食飯 in 飲食飯店, 好食 in 喜好食物, 點解 in 早點解決.

patterns.re: (?:行|食|走|做|講|睇|買|去|嚟|瞓|等|沖|洗)先(?![進生例鋒導輩前天知覺決後])
patterns.why: 粵語把「先」放在動詞後（你行先＝你先走），書面中文放前面。lookahead 排除跨詞巧合：實行先進、演講先生

patterns.re: (?:食|行|做|講|睇|嚟|去|瞓|等)緊(?!急|張|要|密|縮|接|缺|跟|握|咬|逼|記|固|實|貼|靠|湊|擁|壓|催|盯|迫)
patterns.why: 粵語進行式「V緊」（我食緊飯＝我正在吃飯）。lookahead 排除零食緊缺、緊急、緊張這類
粵語雙賓語語序（畀本書我＝給我一本書）；「畀」在現代書面中文幾乎不出現

weak.呢個: 他呢個性很強（少見但存在）

phrase_only.係: 標準中文也用：關係、係數（所以只能出現在詞組鍵裡）
phrase_only.唔: 普通話也有感嘆詞「唔」；粵語用法是「不」，只收進 convertPhrases 與 phrases
phrase_only.睇: 古漢語「睇」＝看；現代書面語幾乎只出現在粵語語境，但保守起見只做偵測
phrase_only.畀: 文言「畀予」；但「畀…我」的語序是粵語，所以放在 patterns 裡

convert_only_when_glyph_is_cantonese.啲: 「些」或「的」或「點」都可能（快啲＝快點、呢啲＝這些）→ 不轉
convert_only_when_glyph_is_cantonese.咁: 「這麼」或「那麼」或「這樣」→ 只在詞組（咁樣、咁多）裡轉

detect_only_standard_char_phrases.大佬: 意思不只一個（哥哥／老大／招呼語）
detect_only_standard_char_phrases.諗住: 打算／以為，意思不只一個

dropped.咩: 普通話的羊叫聲「咩咩叫」→ 只留詞組「有咩」
dropped.收工: 標準中文也用（＝收尾、下班）
dropped.幾時: 古詩也用（「青天有月來幾時」）
dropped.返工: 標準中文指「重做、退貨返工」，與粵語「上班」撞義
